<!-- generated by `pyauto-brain intake dashboard --apply` on 2026-08-19 — regenerate, do not hand-edit -->

Every task the Mind is holding, on one page: what is in flight, what is parked, and the whole backlog to pick from. Pick a line, then run `/start_dev <prompt-path>` to start it. On a phone, tap **📋 copy for Claude** under a task, copy the block, and paste it into a Claude Code chat to route Claude straight to that task.

Tasks only — the organism's health lives with the Heart (`/health`), not here.
